title: Project-agnostic test case
description: One executable case for any unit under test. setup/inputs/expected are free-form objects whose vocabulary is defined by the project profile at projects/<project>/profile.json -- that is what keeps this schema usable for a stateless function and a stateful object alike.

unit.description: The unit under test, matching a name in the profile's `units`.

setup.description: Preconditions established before the call. Empty for a stateless unit.

inputs.description: Arguments passed to the unit. Empty when it takes none.

expected.description: Every observable outcome the profile declares: return value, state variables, output, or exception.

partition.description: Name of the equivalence class or boundary side this case represents.

rationale.description: Why this case represents that class and no other.
